reuse.why: Extends the existing isWeekendOrHoliday predicate, which every holiday check in the tree (date shifting, shift window, schedule-template, server app) already goes through, and reuses monthUtils.dayFromDate.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the MM-DD match is a single extra includes() in the one shared predicate.

placement.why: The holiday-matching rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where the tree already defines it.

scope.why: Only the predicate, two focused tests and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: Very small and clear; the day.slice(5) trick is slightly implicit but is documented by a comment.
